name: Brainwashed Noble
summary: Deep in the caverns outside the Deadmines, Brainwashed Noble remains in Defias hands. Enchantment has stripped him of his will, and he now guards their refuge beside undead minions instead of walking Stormwind's grand halls.

sections.title: A Pawn of the Brotherhood
sections.body: Brainwashed Noble wanders the passages into the Deadmines among bandits and rotting corpses. His highborn finery points to Stormwind's House of Nobles, perhaps as a sitting member or a scion. Edwin VanCleef took him captive. The Defias chose enchantment over ransom and bent his mind into that of a spellcasting guard for their sanctuary. Their hatred for the peers who refused to pay after Stormwind was rebuilt reaches even into the caverns beneath Westfall.

faq.answer: Brainwashed Noble is an aristocratic human thought to belong to Stormwind's House of Nobles. The Defias Brotherhood captured and magically subdued him deep in the Deadmines caverns.

faq.q: Why is a Stormwind noble inside the Deadmines caves?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood holds a bitter grudge against Stormwind's aristocracy over debts left unpaid after the city was rebuilt. A captured noble gives them magical labor and a means of personal vengeance.

faq.q: Where can the Brainwashed Noble be found?
faq.answer: Brainwashed Noble wanders the cavern tunnels of Moonbrook that lead toward the Deadmines entrance, among passages inhabited by skeletal undead.
No one knows which caster brainwashed him. Renegade spellcasters and enchanters among the Defias in Westfall can bend a captive's mind through sorcery.

angles.text: As a human, seeing a peer of the realm reduced to a mindless sentry beneath Westfall shows how deep the Defias Brotherhood's grudge runs against Stormwind's ruling elite.
As a mage, you can recognize Brainwashed Noble's magical staves and arcane tricks, such as Polymorph. They suggest he received formal magical training in the capital before his mind was shattered.
